message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More | |-------|------------|--------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates; 45 mph on urban interstates.
• 35 mph on most rural highways, 25 mph on county roads.
• School zones: 20 mph (or 15 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001‑545.004 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Back‑to‑front seats for children under 2. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held devices prohibited while driving (unless hands‑free).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers ≥ 21.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers < 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021‑545.023 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs; yield at yield signs.
• “Left‑turn on red” allowed after a full stop unless sign prohibits. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001‑545.004 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children.
• No passing on either side of a stopped bus with flashing red lights. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• No “lane‑splitting” on highways. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking in front of fire hydrants.
• Parking in handicap spaces requires valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections required in some counties (e.g., Dallas, Harris). | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway, LBJ Freeway).
• Electronic toll collection (TxTag) recommended. | TxDOT Toll Operations | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website for statutes, regulations, and updates. 2. **Texas Legislature Online** – Access the Texas Transportation Code and recent amendments. 3. **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances (e.g., parking restrictions). --- ### Quick Tips for Drivers - **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety and may vary by road type. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or text while driving. - **Check your vehicle’s registration and inspection status** before traveling long distances. - **Be extra cautious around school zones** – speeds drop significantly and children may be present. Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any specific area (e.g., DUI penalties, toll rates, or local ordinances).
